title: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A knight and sorceress who fights through sleeping knights at Castle Ardenvale and is seduced by Eriette's offer to become her heir.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's twin brother, who sends a letter begging her to come home.

entities.name: Eriette
aliases: Eriette of the Court of the Ardent Queen
entities.description: A witch who created the Wicked Slumber and reveals herself as Rowan's aunt, offering to teach her and make her heir.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A faceless planeswalker, friend and counselor to Eriette, who conjures illusions of Rowan's parents and says Rowan's spark is gone.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: Rowan's stepmother, who saved her from Rowan's birth mother.

entities.name: Rowan's mother
entities.description: Eriette's sister and a witch, killed by Rowan's father after she tried to drink Rowan and Will's blood.

entities.name: Syr Saxon
entities.description: A ranger under the Slumber's control who attacks Rowan with a bone axe.

entities.name: Syr Joshua the Beast Tamer
entities.description: A knight under the Slumber's control who attacks Rowan with a warhammer.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae hero who climbs a beanstalk to a giant's castle and is seized by Beluna.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Kellan's friend, a red-cloaked girl who suspects the fae and is wary of Troyan.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: A blue-skinned guide and professional wanderer who claims not to be born in Eldraine and gives them frog potions.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Ruby's injured brother who gave all his savings to hire Troyan.

entities.name: Beluna
entities.description: A giant lady whose birthday party it is and who owns the goose Albiorix; she seizes Kellan.

entities.name: Lord Yorvo
entities.description: A crowned man with a plant beard, apparently the Giant King, who declares the intruders his guests.

entities.name: Albiorix
entities.description: A goose the size of a market cart owned by Beluna.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Faerie Lord who gave Kellan his quest.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch whose location Kellan seeks, shown in the mirror as an ice castle.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: A magic mirror that reveals information if told something it has not heard before.

entities.name: The Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse created by Eriette that puts people into dream states while their bodies serve her will.

entities.name: Court of the Ardent Queen
entities.description: The shadow-veiled court in Castle Ardenvale where Eriette holds court.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The ruined royal castle now filled with slumbering knights and Eriette's court.

entities.name: Stormkeld
entities.description: The giants' castle at the top of the beanstalk.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: A lake where Ruby fished as a child, shown in the mirror with an ice castle.

entities.name: Garenbrig
entities.description: A giant city from which the Giant King vanished during the invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose bodies lie beneath the mist around Ardenvale.

entities.name: Giants of Stormkeld
entities.description: The giants who are holding a waltzing birthday party.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The fairy tale plane devastated by the Phyrexian invasion and plagued by the Wicked Slumber.

events.summary: Rowan receives a letter from Will asking her to come home but refuses to return, sending him a blank page.
events.quote: "Give him this, and tell him to come find me if he's serious."

events.summary: Rowan blasts through Castle Ardenvale's gates and fights her way up the stairs through slumbering knights who attack her, including Saxon and Joshua.
events.quote: Aiming at his feet and Saxon's, she channels another blast.

events.summary: Rowan is swept into a waltz of slumbering knights and met by Ashiok in the Court of the Ardent Queen.
events.quote: "Welcome to the Court of the Ardent Queen, Rowan Kenrith."

events.summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
events.quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

events.summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
events.quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

events.summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
events.quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

events.summary: Eriette offers Rowan power and tells her the Slumber grants dreamers their wishes while their bodies serve her will.
Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
events.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

events.summary: Kellan and Ruby climb a beanstalk with the guide Troyan, who gives them frog potions for the leap to the clouds.
events.quote: "Pretty cool, huh? Don't worry, it's only temporary," Troyan says.

events.summary: Kellan and Ruby leap to Stormkeld, the giants' castle, and slip inside while the giants waltz.
The giant Beluna's goose chases them and Beluna seizes Kellan, accusing them of trying to steal the mirror at her birthday party.
events.quote: "What are you doing at my party?"

events.summary: Lord Yorvo, apparently the Giant King, makes Kellan and his friends his guests and persuades Beluna to show them the mirror.
events.quote: "Consider you and yours my guests at this party."

events.summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
events.quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

relations.quote: Has anyone told you you look just like your mother?
